name: aws-step-functions-workflow
title: Step Functions workflow
summary: Runs the Lambda functions it is linked to, one after another in the order of the links, passing each one's result to the next and retrying a step that fails with backoff. Start it from the AWS console, the API, or another service.
checks: Runs its linked functions in the order of the links, retrying a failed step up to {retries} times
A {type} workflow; each step may take at most {timeout_seconds} seconds
Its role can start only the functions it is linked to

type.title: Kind
type.description: STANDARD keeps each run's history for 90 days and can run up to a year; EXPRESS is for short, high-volume runs of up to 5 minutes.
